title: Effect of the OFDMA Downlink Scheduler on User Throughput and Fairness
aim: Compare Round Robin, Maximum C/I, and Proportional Fair downlink schedulers using per-user throughput, total throughput, and Jain fairness.
parameters: Six users with mean SNR = 25, 20, 15, 10, 5, and 0 dB
Rayleigh fading with exponential power gain
Proportional Fair forgetting factor = 0.99; random seed = 1
method: Compute instantaneous rate r = log2(1 + SNR*gain). Simulate Round Robin, Max C/I, and Proportional Fair, accumulate throughput, and calculate Jain fairness for each policy.
result: Max C/I gives the highest total throughput (7.906 b/s/Hz) but lowest fairness (0.264). Proportional Fair balances throughput (5.576 b/s/Hz) with best fairness (0.778). Round Robin gives 3.861 b/s/Hz and fairness 0.741.
